text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
“I came here giving everything I've got
to 
beat you, Bono!” Hishi Akebono took Biko 
Pegasus's earnest words straight to heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Exchanging fierce declarations of war—
the 
battle of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen has 
begun!
